Macquarie Group LTD Has Lifted Its China Mobile Limited (CHL) Position; Voya Investment Management Lowered Apple (AAPL) Position By $133.41 Million
June 1, 2018 - By Michael Collier
Voya Investment Management Llc decreased Apple Inc (AAPL) stake by 11.26% reported in 2018Q1 SEC filing. Voya Investment Management Llc sold 798,877 shares as Apple Inc (AAPL)’s stock rose 5.37%. The Voya Investment Management Llc holds 6.30 million shares with $1.06 billion value, down from 7.09M last quarter. Apple Inc now has $933.24B valuation. The stock increased 1.61% or $3 during the last trading session, reaching $189.87. About 18.11 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 1, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
Macquarie Group Ltd increased China Mobile Limited (CHL) stake by 2.3% reported in 2018Q1 SEC filing. Macquarie Group Ltd acquired 78,109 shares as China Mobile Limited (CHL)’s stock declined 4.22%. The Macquarie Group Ltd holds 3.47M shares with $158.78 million value, up from 3.39M last quarter. China Mobile Limited now has $186.20B valuation. The stock increased 0.85% or $0.38 during the last trading session, reaching $45.3. About 350,064 shares traded. China Mobile Limited (NYSE:CHL) has declined 15.14% since June 1, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 27.71% the S&P500.
